purpose: Deterministic fixture world for the Utah Water Measurement Data Dashboard contracts (WD-002). Every test that consumes these fixtures must pin this seed and the fixed clock so results are reproducible. All fixture data is synthetic; no real measurements, gate codes, credentials or personal data appear here.
dst_note: US Mountain Daylight Time began 2026-03-08 at 02:00 MST (-07:00), springing forward to 03:00 MDT (-06:00); equivalently the offset changes at 2026-03-08T09:00:00Z. The fixed clock 2026-03-09T07:00:00Z is 2026-03-09 01:00 MDT, the first Monday after the transition. Observation series deliberately span the transition: sourceOffset is -07:00 before 2026-03-08T09:00:00Z and -06:00 from that instant, and the local calendar day 2026-03-08 has only 23 hours.
axis_order_note: Station geometry is EPSG:4326 latitude/longitude. Utah fixture latitudes are 41.2-42.0 N and longitudes -113.0 to -111.4 W, so |latitude| (~41-42) differs from |longitude| (~111-113) by roughly 70 degrees; any latitude/longitude swap or WMS 1.3.0 EPSG:4326 axis-order mistake displaces a point far outside Utah and is immediately detectable. See the header note in stations.json.
